verdict.rationale: Mixpanel exposes substantial API surface (Ingestion, Query, Raw Export, Engage, Feature Flags, JQL) covering most core analytics data operations, and an MCP server lets AI assistants query events/funnels/retention/replays via natural language, but some UI-only features (e.g., Session Replay sampling configuration, dashboard visual creation/interactivity, and cohort creation in-UI) are explicitly noted as UI-managed with no code/API path, and MCP tools listed are limited (e.g., create-dashboard) rather than full parity with the UI's breadth of reporting configuration. missing for 10: evidence of API/MCP parity for session replay sampling config, full dashboard customization, and cohort/property management equivalent to the UI.
